'''2004 World Championship Day 2 Reid Smith DS Carbon Chamber Testing''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Reid Smith]] at [[2004 World Championship]] (Day 2); the list below is as posted on DeckTech by R. "Voice of Law" Smith (2005-02-08).<ref name="src">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=34436 Effect WarZ FINAL]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20070922002206/http://www.decktech.net:80/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=34436 Internet Archive]</ref>

'''Note:''' "FINAL" version posted Feb 2005 after several events (Ohio money tournament, Origins 2004, Worlds 2004 Day 2); not stated card-for-card for Worlds 2004.<ref name="src" />
